items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: it seems we heard more of Ma Rainey than we did of Bessie at that time, Bessie Smith.

ctx.x: And you did realize at that age how famous she was?

Well, I did, because see she had records out, you know. We used to have the old wind up, crank Victrola, they called them Victrolas in that time, and we had her records, you know. So we did realize that she was a very famous woman at that time. I think even moreso at that time than Bessie, in our particular area you know, neck of the woods. I don't know why, but it seems we heard more of Ma Rainey than we did of Bessie at that time, Bessie Smith.
Do you have any particular recollections about her as a person or about her approach?
